glosses: To speak unintelligibly or inaudibly; to fail to articulate.

examples.text: Please try not to mumble so I can hear you better.
A wrinkled hag, with age grown double, / Picking dry sticks, and mumbling to herself.

glosses: To chew something gently with closed lips.
A quiet or unintelligible vocalization; a low tone of voice.

examples.text: All I could hear was a mumble from the next room.
He spoke in a barely comprehensible mumble.
